values.note: $12 per site per night, plus $5 per additional vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/halfmoon-campground ('Single Site: $12 per night', 'Additional Vehicle: $5 per night'; last updated May 1, 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 32 ft is the ACCESS ROAD limit ('Access road not suitable for vehicles longer than 32''); trailer/RV parking spurs average 24 x 60 ft.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/halfmoon-campground ('Camp sites: 12', 'Access road not suitable for vehicles longer than 32'', 'Trailer/RV Sites Average Parking Spur: 24' x 60''), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water Memorial Day through Labor Day. No trash pickup, no firewood.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/halfmoon-campground (Restrooms 'Vault toilet(s)'; Water 'Potable water is available at this site. Memorial Day thru Labor Day.'; 'Trash Pickup: No', 'Firewood: No'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FS Seasons of Use: 'All Year.' Access is limited in fall and winter by snow; water only Memorial Day - Labor Day.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/halfmoon-campground (Seasons of Use 'All Year.'; 'Access is limited during the fall and winter due to snow.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin NF (Yellowstone RD) campground along Big Timber Creek in the glacier-carved Crazy Mountains: 11 miles north of Big Timber on US 191, then 12 miles west on gravel Big Timber Canyon Rd. Trails, nearby waterfalls and fishing; picnic sites next to the campground. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated May 1, 2026) confirms $12 (+$5 extra vehicle), FCFS, 12 sites, 32-ft access road limit (spurs 24x60), vault toilets, drinking water. Changed season Jun 1 - Sep 1 (derived) -> year-round per 'Seasons of Use: All Year.' (snow limits access; water Memorial Day - Labor Day). rec.gov has only a POI (236090), not a bookable facility. No alert for Halfmoon. Hookups (derived none) left. Note trimmed of restated values.
